# Demo Evidence Recorder

Use this skill whenever meaningful work is completed or a delivery decision is made.

## Purpose
Ensure the primary deliverable — the explainable Copilot AI workflow — remains visible, current, and reproducible.

## Instructions
- Record which Copilot capability was used:
  - chat
  - agent
  - skill
  - MCP integration
  - APM-installed customization
- Capture:
  - objective
  - inputs or prompts
  - outputs
  - decisions made
  - verification performed
  - artifacts produced
- Update the relevant documentation when work changes the project story.
- Prefer concise, factual entries over marketing language.
- Note human approval points and unresolved follow-ups.

## Documents to update when relevant
- `docs/copilot-usage-guide.md`
- `docs/agent-execution-log.md`
- `docs/mcp-integration-summary.md`
- `docs/demo-script.md`
- `docs/apm-inventory.md`

## Evidence checklist
For each major activity, record:
- what was requested
- what Copilot asset handled it
- what files or artifacts changed
- how the result was validated
- what a reviewer should inspect
